observation_summary: A ClassCastException occurs during type resolution when a typedef resolves to a type that is not an ObjectType.
reasoning_summary: The code in FunctionType.java performs an explicit cast of the result of 'safeResolve' to 'ObjectType' without verifying that the resolved type is actually an instance of 'ObjectType'. When a typedef resolves to a non-object type (like a StringType or a UnionType), the cast fails at runtime, triggering a ClassCastException. The code assumes that the resolved type will always be an ObjectType, which is an invalid assumption when dealing with arbitrary JSDoc typedefs.
